name: commit_brief
title: commit_brief
description: Lock in the game design brief after clarifying with the human. Call this only when you have enough detail to build well — including whether the game is 2D or 3D. After this succeeds, the build tools unlock and you should implement the brief. Never invent a generic game to fill gaps; ask_user first.

title.description: Short working title for the game.

dimensions.description: Whether this is a 2D or 3D Godot project. Required — never guess.

genre.description: Genre label, e.g. 'first-person shooter', 'top-down puzzle', 'side-scrolling platformer'.

summary.description: One-paragraph description of what the player experiences.

core_loop.description: The repeating gameplay loop in a few sentences.

controls.description: How the player moves and acts (keys, mouse, touch).

win_lose.description: Win and fail conditions, or 'sandbox / no win state' if none.

scope.description: Concrete MVP for this session: scenes, systems, and what is deliberately out of scope.

art_direction.description: Visual style: primitives, palette, camera feel. Prefer buildable placeholders over asset wishlists.

technical_notes.description: Godot-specific choices: root node types, physics bodies, scene layout.
